info.name: Mend Access Management Dependencies Source Files API
Get source files inventory at project level

params.name: limit
params.description: Specifies the maximum number of items to be returned in the response.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Parameter indicates the starting point for retrieving results, the first call doesn't include a cursor parameter in the request, the API response includes the first set of results along with a cursor pointing to the last item retrieved.

items.docs: Returns an inventory list of the source files associated with each library in a project. Supports filtering by library UUID using the search parameter. Example: ?search=libraryUuid==b366b0ef-b211-4c37-a47c-0077e4de709f

info.name: Get Mend library suggestions for source files at project level

items.docs: Returns Mend library suggestions for the specified source file UUIDs. Request body requires: sourceFileUuids (array), recommendedForAllFiles (boolean). Supports same search filters as searchForMatch: date, license, name, owner, version.

info.name: Search for library matches for source files at project level

items.docs: Returns library match suggestions from Mend based on manual search criteria. Uses V3 MQL search format. Available search filters: date:between:date1,date2 (e.g., between:2019-05-01,2019-06-01), license:[like|regex]:value, name:[like|equals|regex]:value, owner:like:value, version:like:value. Example: ?search=name==openssl.

info.name: Get source files inventory at application level

params.name: limit
params.description: Specifies the maximum number of items to be returned in the response.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Parameter indicates the starting point for retrieving results, the first call doesn't include a cursor parameter in the request, the API response includes the first set of results along with a cursor pointing to the last item retrieved.

items.docs: Returns a list of libraries together with the location of their source files. Supports filtering by library UUID using the search parameter. Example: ?search=libraryUuid==b366b0ef-b211-4c37-a47c-0077e4de709f

info.name: Get Mend library suggestions for source files at application level

items.docs: Returns Mend library suggestions for the specified source file UUIDs. Request body requires: sourceFileUuids (array), recommendedForAllFiles (boolean). Supports same search filters as searchForMatch: date, license, name, owner, version.

info.name: Search for library matches for source files at application level

items.docs: Returns library match suggestions from Mend based on manual search criteria. Uses V3 MQL search format. Available search filters: date:between:date1,date2 (e.g., between:2019-05-01,2019-06-01), license:[like|regex]:value, name:[like|equals|regex]:value, owner:like:value, version:like:value. Example: ?search=name==openssl.

info.name: Remap source files at application level

params.name: orgUuid
params.description: org UUID (from the Mend App: **Administration** General > **Organization UUID**).

items.docs: Remaps the specified source files to a target library for the specified application(s). This operation runs asynchronously and returns 202 Accepted with async process status. Requires exactly one of: targetLibraryUuid OR matchSuggestionId (not both, not neither). Request body fields: applicationUuids (required, array), sourceFileUuids (required, array), targetLibraryUuid (conditional), matchSuggestionId (conditional), comment (optional), sendEmailNotification (optional, boolean).

info.name: Remap source files at organization level

params.name: orgUuid
params.description: org UUID (from the Mend App: **Administration** General > **Organization UUID**).

items.docs: Remaps the specified source files to a target library across the entire organization. This operation runs asynchronously and returns 202 Accepted with async process status. Requires exactly one of: targetLibraryUuid OR matchSuggestionId (not both, not neither). Request body fields: sourceFileUuids (required, array), targetLibraryUuid (conditional), matchSuggestionId (conditional), comment (optional), sendEmailNotification (optional, boolean).
